metadata.question: Were blooms of phytoplankton visible in the Norwegian Sea during June 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (optical data, good for phytoplankton blooms via chlorophyll/true color) - Date: Around June 5, 2019 (allow ±5 days for cloud-free imagery) - Location: Norwegian Sea (approximate bounds: 60-75°N, 0-20°E) - Alternative: Landsat 8 if Sentinel-2 fails 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud masking is critical—phytoplankton blooms are subtle and obscured by clouds - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 or BQA for Landsat - Calculate NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) or examine true color composite - Phytoplankton blooms show elevated chlorophyll (high NDCI or bright turquoise in RGB) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (B) from Null/Error (C): - If no cloud-free pixels exist (C2): collection exists but all pixels masked - If collection empty (C1): no images found in date/location - If NDCI calculation fails or returns NaN (C3): calculation error - If NDCI is low/no bloom detected (B): Valid answer, no bloom - If NDCI is elevated or bloom signature visible (A): Bloom detected - Phytoplankton blooms typically show NDCI > 0.1 in areas with high chlorophyll ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Norwegian Sea region const norseaSea = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([0, 60, 20, 75]); // Target date: June 5, 2019 ± 5 days const startDate = '2019-06-01'; const endDate = '2019-06-10'; // Sentinel-2 collection with cloud filtering let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(norseaSea) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 images found. Trying Landsat 8...'); col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(norseaSea) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const colSizeLandsat = col.size().getInfo(); if (colSizeLandsat === 0) { console.log('No data found for Norwegian Sea, June 5 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } } console.log(`Images found: ${colSize > 0 ? colSize : col.size().getInfo()}`); // Use median composite to reduce noise const composite = col.median(); // Calculate NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) // NDCI = (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) for Sentinel-2 const ndci = composite.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDCI'); // Also check pixel validity const validPixels = ndci.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: norseaSea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI').getInfo(); if (validPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean NDCI const meanNDCI = ndci.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: norseaSea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI').getInfo(); // Calculate max NDCI (phytoplankton bloom indicator) const maxNDCI = ndci.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: norseaSea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDCI').getInfo(); if (meanNDCI === null || isNaN(meanNDCI)) { console.log('NDCI calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Composite images: ${colSize > 0 ? colSize : col.size().getInfo()}`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validPixels}`); console.log(`Mean NDCI: ${meanNDCI.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Max NDCI: ${maxNDCI.toFixed(4)}`); // Phytoplankton blooms typically show NDCI > 0.1 (elevated chlorophyll) // Strong blooms: NDCI > 0.15 const bloomThreshold = 0.10; if (maxNDCI > bloomThreshold) { console.log(`Bloom signature detected (max NDCI ${maxNDCI.toFixed(4)} > ${bloomThreshold})`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`No significant phytoplankton bloom detected (max NDCI ${maxNDCI.toFixed(4)} ≤ ${bloomThreshold})`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
